Never have I felt the need to post a review on any game (good or bad), but the atrocity they gave to the public this year is unacceptable. The amount of bugs and glitches are inexcusable. Franchise mode has been borderline unplayable. Superstar single player mode might possibly be the worst game mode in a sports game in all of history. The play calls that you are limited to choosing are all terrible, your CPU teammates are worse than a newborn baby picking up a controller, and it makes the "grind" of the mode completely unenjoyable. I have been a yearly Madden purchaser and I think this year will be the final year of that pattern. If you would like to waste $70 of your money I would highly recommend playing the lottery instead of buying this game. Losing the lottery would be more fun than whatever this is. It's embarrassing that this is the product of a $50+ billion franchise.
